requirement_alignment: Actual PNG inspected; all visible text English; planned monetary comparisons present
data_expression_quality: Mapped saved effects and intervals or exact monthly costs; no smoothed or fabricated data
style_preservation: Selected horizontal gradient bar or composite line-bar template structure and serif style retained
readability: Labels, scales, markers and legends are readable; negative months visible
layout_quality: Actual final PNG has separate title/summary/legend bands and no clipping or label collisions
color_quality: Muted teal-blue or blue-orange palette; policy line styles and inventory shape differentiate quantities
